items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: The interviewee identifies himself as Richard Charles Howard Smith. The person to judge is Richard B. Allen. There is no mention of any interaction, relationship, or connection between the interviewee and Richard B. Allen in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, I was born into the Smith clan. My name is Richard, and to make me different, they decided to name me Richard Charles Howard Smith. A lot of relatives got in the act there.
Well, that would be good for a trumpet player. You know, you get the Howard in there.
